name: Ω Production Assurance Plane
purpose: Unify source-derived production gates into one auditable promotion decision without replacing canonical identity, event, evidence, mission, capability, lineage, deployment, or provider systems.

gates.description: Source requirements are mapped to canonical runtime systems and truth states.
Architectural immune-system checks are healthy or explicitly waived with accountable evidence.
Identity and protected actions are governed by server-authoritative authorization.
Authoritative state changes emit governed platform events.
Protected outcomes have authoritative evidence or are explicitly UNAVAILABLE/UNVERIFIED.
Mission/task progression uses canonical server-authoritative transitions.
Advertised capabilities resolve to registered, governed runtime capabilities.
Material outputs identify authoritative source and transformation lineage.
External providers are configured, authorized, failure-tested, idempotent, and production-proven before LIVE claims.
Production deployment is healthy and the tested commit is traceable to the intended release.
Required authentication, MFA, RLS, secrets, storage and security controls have current evidence.
Backup, restore, retention and deletion controls have current evidence.
Operational failures and important state transitions are observable and auditable.
Automated contract tests and production smoke evidence cover the promoted capability.

promotionRules.waiver: Requires accountable owner, reason, expiry, compensating control and evidence reference.
